item_short_desc: Keep your shirt looking sharp and professional all day with Rothco’s Shirt Stays. This 4-pack of shirt stays is designed with a durable polyester / cotton blend, providing comfort and long-lasting wear. The elastic tension keeps your shirt neatly tucked, ensuring a clean and tailored appearance throughout the day. Metal clips securely attach to the shirt tail and socks, preventing any slipping or loosening as you move. These shirt stays are adjustable, offering a custom fit for any size.
